entities.name: Fiers
entities.description: Dwarf revered as the god of fire and red magic by Dominaria's dwarves and Otarian barbarians; brother of Gaea, possibly a planeswalker.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: False god who summoned Fiers as deity of red magic.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: Sister of Fiers who created the world with him.

entities.name: Lady of the Mountain
entities.description: Being Fiers helped create in the myth.

entities.name: Balthor Rockfist
entities.description: Dwarf who summoned the power of Fiers to destroy Burke.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Believer who mentions Fiers in her speeches.

entities.name: Burke
entities.description: Being destroyed by the power of Fiers.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Revealed that only a god's power could kill Burke.

entities.name: Corus
entities.description: Shiv viashino who swears by Fiers.

events.summary: Fiers finishes creating the spine of Dominaria, leaving his body pale and scarred.
events.quote: After he finished creating the spine of Dominaria

events.summary: In the myth, Fiers helps Gaea create the world and creates the dwarves.
events.quote: He created the dwarves of the plane on his own

events.summary: Balthor summons Fiers's power, a continual bolt of lightning that destroys Burke.
events.quote: Balthor Rockfist summoned the power of Fiers

events.summary: Karona summons Fiers and other figures, a meeting later retconned.

relations.quote: He is described as Gaea's brother
also helped create the Lady of the Mountain
